Accumulate-and-scale: sums the u16 fields at a0+2/a0+4 back into a0+2, v = (sum >> 8) & 0xFF clamped to 127 (zeroing byte a0+0 when clamped), returns a0->8 * (floatTable[v] - 1.0f) + 1.0f with the table at reloc-blind &D_00000000 + 0x200. The 98.48% wrap had two spelling residuals: (1) int temp one register low (sll t8 vs target sll t9) -- fixed by the 20E24 shift-merge phantom, spelling the table index as a short-index shift (short *)&D + 0x100 + (v << 1) so uopt merges the << 1 with the halfword scale into one sll v0,2 while the pre-merge temp burns $t8; (2) FP temp ring + mul operand order -- cfe ranks the register-rooted cast-deref *(float *)(a0 + 8) first when it is the textually-second operand, so it is written textually first (a0->8 * (tbl - 1.0f)), giving tbl -> $f4, sub -> $f6, a0->8 -> $f8, mul.s f10,f6,f8. Validated in a standalone harness whose control reproduces the in-tree bytes; typed one- and two-level member chains for the a0+8 operand are byte-identical alternatives.
